environment.description: Same ECS Fargate task in the same VPC. The task role (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/ServiceMeshGateway) retains identical inline policies granting s3:*, sts:AssumeRole, and ec2:Describe*. However, the role has an attached permission boundary policy (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:policy/EnforcedBoundary-Tier2Services) which contains an explicit Deny with Effect:Deny on Resource:'*' for actions ['s3:GetObject','s3:PutObject','s3:DeleteObject','sts:AssumeRole','ec2:RunInstances','ec2:TerminateInstances','iam:*','lambda:InvokeFunction','ssm:SendCommand','ssm:StartSession'] with a Condition key of aws:ViaAWSService set to false. Additionally, an SCP (id: scp-a8b3c9d2e1f04567) attached at the OU level denies sts:AssumeRole when the principal ARN matches the task role pattern unless aws:PrincipalTag/automation-approved equals 'true'. The task role does not carry this tag. IMDSv1 remains accessible from the container network namespace and the metadata credential endpoint returns valid temporary credentials for the task role.

config.scp_denies: sts:AssumeRole when principal lacks tag automation-approved=true
